subject: Your {{productName}} account will be deleted on {{purgeDate}}
previewText: Your {{productName}} account will be deleted on {{purgeDate}}
paragraph1: We've received your request to delete your {{productName}} account. It's locked now, so nobody can sign in to it.
paragraph2: On {{purgeDate}} we'll permanently delete your data. Uploaded files are removed 30 days after that. If you didn't mean to do this, reply to this email or contact privacy@ozer.so before {{purgeDate}} and we'll restore your account.
paragraph3: We thank you again for using {{productName}}.
